basic_profile.bio: I'm a budding real estate investor based in Austin, Texas. I recently transitioned from a career in software development to explore opportunities in real estate. I love learning about new investment strategies and I'm passionate about craft beer and live music, often spending weekends at local breweries or at music festivals. Typically online in the evenings after work. Currently single and focusing on building my investment portfolio.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in software development, having worked in the tech industry for several years. My interest in real estate was sparked by reading books and attending seminars. I’m currently self-teaching through online courses and actively participating in real estate forums.
